trait.name: Hit Dice
entries: The Mercenary has a number of {@dice d10} Hit Dice equal to your level. It benefits from short and long rests.

trait.name: Morale
entries: If you fall to 0 hit points your Mercenary flees.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage.

bonus.name: Brutal
entries: The Mercenary makes a {@action Shove} or {@action Grapple}.
